description.value: Buffalo Inn is a motel situated at Mile 143 of the iconic Alaska Highway in northern British Columbia, placing it squarely on one of the world's great long-distance cycling routes. The Alaska Highway corridor sees steady traffic from touring cyclists making multi-week journeys between Dawson Creek and Alaska, making roadside lodging at this milepost a meaningful stopping point. The commercial building and highway-side location suggest a classic roadhouse-style motel serving travellers in a remote stretch of BC.
